Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

And are you looking for a flexible job that fits your lifestyle?

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

SD Worx Jobs is looking for a logistics associate for a client located in Kruisem. 

Your tasks will be as follows:

• Helping to prepare orders with a scanning system

• Packing goods

• Labelling and marking 

• Performing quality checks

• You speak and understand English.

• Preferably, you have experience as an order picker.

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

You will support the Customer Service team with tasks such as order entry, stock assignment, requests of certificates, etc.

 As you will progress in your training, the responsibilities can be expanded to direct customer support and coordination of the full order to cash process for a selected amount of customers.

• Act as a key point of contact for assigned customers and provide professional and timely support.
• Manage the end-to-end order process, including order entry, verification, delivery coordination and invoicing.
• Maintain accurate customer and order information in the systems.
• Provide customers and Sales colleagues with clear updates on order and delivery status.
• Prepare relevant documentation, including order confirmations, delivery documents and certificates.
• Respond to customer inquiries and help resolve order, delivery, pricing or product-related questions.
• Register and follow up on customer complaints, returns and other order-related issues.
• Work closely with Sales and internal stakeholders to ensure an efficient customer experience.
• Collaborate with colleagues across Customer Service, Supply Chain, Sales, Quality and other departments.
 

• You have experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management, Administration or a similar environment. 
• You are customer-focused, organized and comfortable managing different priorities and administrative tasks.
• You communicate clearly and enjoy working with customers and colleagues from different countries and cultures.
• You are confident working with Microsoft Excel, Outlook and Teams.
• Experience with SAP or another ERP system is considered a strong advantage.
• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.
• Knowledge of Russian is an additional asset, but is not required.
• You work accurately, take ownership and enjoy contributing to a collaborative team environment.

As an operator, together with a colleague, you are responsible for operating and setting up the production line. You use an overhead crane, set the correct parameters and knife distances, and make sure the rolls are properly packaged. Some administrative work on the computer is also part of your job. You work in two fixed shifts: from 5 a.m. to 1 p.m. or from 1 p.m. to 9 p.m.
Every day is varied: setting up machines, performing quality checks, and processing production documentation. You are alert to safety and contribute to a smooth production process.
Does this job appeal to you? Apply now!

• Relevant experience as an operator

• Technical insight and logical thinking

• Good computer skills

• Attention to quality and safety

• Stress-resistant and result-oriented

• Team player

• You speak fluent Dutch or English

Do you enjoy working with a forklift and appreciate order? This forklift operator position allows you to support the entire production process. 

You make sure raw materials and finished products are always in the right place to keep operations running smoothly.Your typical day starts by checking your forklift. You supply the necessary materials according to the production schedule and safely store finished goods in the designated locations.

Does this job sound interesting? Apply quickly and make a difference as a forklift operator!

• You have experience as a forklift operator or in a similar role
• You speak fluent Dutch, English, or French
• You work safely and precisely
• You take initiative to report problems or defects
• You are willing to work in two shifts

As a Welder, you are responsible for welding aluminum profiles with quality and precision. You make sure every profile is processed according to the agreed guidelines, playing an important role in the production of design lighting fixtures.

A typical day includes operating the welding robot or TIG welding machine, preparing and cutting profiles, and setting the rolling machine. Together with your colleagues, you follow up on the order lists to ensure everything is completed accurately and on time. You work with great attention to detail and strive for a neat end result each time.

Are you passionate about technology and enjoy working with your hands? Do you want to be part of a team where you help create unique products? Apply quickly and discover this opportunity!

• Technical background
• Training in metalwork is a plus
• Experience as a welder (aluminum)
• You work accurately and pay attention to detail
• Good knowledge of Dutch or English

Our client is a global marketing services organization specializing in multi-channel B2B & B2C marketing solutions that connect their clients with their customers in powerful ways. Experts in defining, executing, and optimizing the customer journey, they offer end-to-end marketing services including consulting, strategic assessment, data, analytics, digital, social, mobile, print, fulfillment, logistics and contact center

solutions. 

Key Responsibilities:

Program & Client Coordination 

 
• Act as the day-to-day operational lead for assigned client programs 
 
• Coordinate all client touchpoints (emails, tickets, calls) in a timely and professional manner 
 
• Facilitate collaboration across internal departments and third-party vendors 
 
• Support the account management teams with their daily client management activities where needed 
 
• Coordinate ongoing program deliverables, reports, meeting notes, and documentation of/updating of project procedures 
 
• Participate in weekly client calls and quarterly business reviews

Project Implementation 
 
• Take ownership of project implementations from initial planning and client alignment through execution, go-live, and post-implementation optimization 
 
• Maintain clear and structured implementation documentation, process flows, and operational procedures 
 
• Continuously evaluate implemented processes and identify opportunities for further optimization, efficiency improvements, and enhanced client experience 
 
• Ensure operational readiness and successful handover into daily business operations after project completion

Client Relationship & Quality Coordination 
 
• Help developing trusted relationships with client services teams and key client stakeholders 
 
• Monitor program health and ensure SLAs, KPIs, and quality standards are consistently met 
 
• Drive process improvements and identify opportunities for optimization 
 
• Handle escalations from issue identification to resolution 
 
• Assist in preparing client audits and quarterly business reviews

Reporting & Financial Coordination 
 
• Prepare internal and external reports (daily, weekly, monthly metrics) 
 
• Support monthly invoicing activities with accuracy and timeliness 

What You Bring: 

 
• Initial successful experience in a similar coordination, operations, or client service role—experience in pharmaceutical, fulfillment, or digital industries is a strong plus 
 
• Strong client-first mindset, focused on understanding client needs and delivering measurable value 
 
• Out-of-the-box mindset to translating client challenges into clear, achievable solutions 
 
• Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational hands-on delivery to ensure solutions actually work for clients 
 
• Ability to combine creative thinking with practical execution 
 
• Analytical, process driven and critical mindset with a continuous improvement focus 
 
• Comfortable working with figures and data 
 
• Strong organizational, administrative and time management skills to handle various deadlines simultaneously 
 
• Proficient written and verbal communication skills in Dutch, French and English (any additional language is a plus) 
 
• Comfortable using Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Word, Teams) 
 
• Ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, external partners and technical teams alike 
 
• Eager to learn and pro-actively take ownership 
 
• Professional Bachelor or university degree preferred

As an operator, you work with the team to produce and process corrugated cardboard. You set up the machines, monitor the process, and check the quality. You solve small malfunctions yourself; for bigger issues, you can turn to the team leader. You work in an orderly, accurate, and independent way. Apply quickly if you like working in 2 shifts!

You speak fluent Dutch and/or English
You enjoy working independently and can operate a machine
You are accurate, tidy, and have an eye for detail
You are a true team player and eager to learn
You have a technical interest or experience (plus)

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

As a maintenance mechanic for trucks, you are responsible for the technical maintenance of trailers. You make sure that everything is ready for inspection and carry out interventions where needed. You replace brakes, shock absorbers and other worn parts. Welding work on trailers is also part of your job.

On a typical day, you start by checking trailers scheduled for inspection. You perform planned maintenance and repair defective parts. You assemble and disassemble components, work independently on repairs and coordinate with colleagues when necessary. If you have knowledge of hydraulics or electricity, that's a plus, but not a must. Communication with colleagues and, if needed, customers is in Dutch, French, English or German.

Do you like to get hands-on and make sure everything is in top technical condition? Are you solution-oriented and prefer to work independently? Apply now and take the first step toward this job!

• You have a diploma of lower secondary education or equivalent by experience

• You have at least 1 year of experience as a mechanic

• You can work independently and think in terms of solutions

• You have strong communication skills

• You have a good command of at least one of these languages: Dutch, French, English or German

• Basic knowledge of hydraulics or electricity is a plus, not a requirement

As a Truck Driver CE, you are responsible for transporting goods within Belgium, Northern France, and Southern Netherlands. You load and unload the truck yourself with an electric pallet truck and always check your documents and vehicle. You register everything correctly in the onboard computer. Ready to hit the road independently? Apply now!

• You have a CE driving license and a valid professional competence certificate (code 95).

• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Truck Driver CE.

• You speak fluent Dutch or English.

• You can work independently and are accurate with administration.

• You are comfortable with a PC and onboard computer.

• You are willing to work an average of 12 hours per day.

• You live within commuting distance to Hooglede.

As a welder, you are responsible for manual and semi-automatic welding of different parts. You work precisely and have an eye for quality, because your workmanship directly impacts the final product.

A typical day involves reading technical plans, preparing materials, and handling welding tasks according to given specifications. You assemble the welded components into a solid, durable end product. You work independently, but can also cooperate with other skilled workers when needed.

Are you handy, detail-oriented, and do you take pride in a perfectly finished product? Then this job is for you. Apply now and show your skills!

• You have a technical background or proven welding experience.

• You can read and accurately follow technical plans.

• You are physically fit and enjoy hands-on work.

• You like working independently and pay attention to detail.

• You speak, write, and understand English.

For a Federale customer in Brussels, I am searching for a freelance DevOps Engineer for a long-term mission to work in an Infrastructure team handling applications which are developed in-house for external users.

 

Responsibilities

 

·         Be part of a DevOps sub team (3) within a larger Infrastructure team (11)

·         Work closely with developers to maintain and implement development tools and pipelines to publish apps into acceptance and test (50/50 split between interaction with infrastructure/development teams)

·         Supply the lead architect with validation of new designs

 

Environment/Technical Experience

 

·         Strong knowledge of Ansible and CI/CD pipelines

·         Experience with Kubernetes and Helm

·         Knowledge of OpenShift

·         Strong knowledge of Microservices architecture

·         Exposure ELK tools

·         Scripting/Python experience

 

Additional Details

 

START DATE: October (ASAP)

DURATION: Until 31/03/2027

EXTENSION: Yes

CONTRACT: Freelance

LOCATION: Brussels

ONSITE POLICY: 2 days per week

HOURS PER WEEK: 40

LANGUAGES: Fluent English, Dutch or French

INTERVIEW PROCESS: 1 Stage

 

If you are interested, please forward your updated resume to jay.kukoyi@vividresourcing.com to be considered.

Looking for a new challenge in supply chain within an international and forward-thinking organization?

As a Supply Chain Assistant you will support the supply chain team with daily tasks such as:

• Manage material availability and inventory levels to ensure uninterrupted operations. 
• Maintain SAP MRP parameters and follow up on shortages, replenishmen, and planning activities. 
• Coordinate with Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering and Operations teams to resolve material-related issues. 
• Analyze KPIs and SAP reports to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
• Support process improvement and optimization initiatives for critical materials and supply chain workflows.

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Good knowledge of SAP, MRP planning and inventory management processes.
• Strong Excel and data analysis skills.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills with a proactive and results-oriented mindset.
